Left thumb: move, push all the way to sprint. Right thumb: drag to look.
Buttons: jump, flash bomb, attack and your bag. Tap the map to enlarge it.
Collect 3 blue shards on each floor to break the seal on the way down. Listen for the chime: it gets louder as you get close.
Every floor hides a sanctuary where nothing can follow you. Its Keeper trades gems for lasting upgrades, the Brewer turns what you find into potions, and the Blacksmith forges weapons.
